title: Karl Mayer opens Textile Innovation Center in Obertshausen
content: # Karl Mayer opens Textile Innovation Center in Obertshausen. Karl Mayer has officially opened its new Textile Innovation Center (TIC) at its headquarters in Obertshausen, marking a significant investment in the future of textile innovation. The opening week, held from April 21 to 24, culminated in a grand ceremony attended by around 220 international guests, including customers, brands and partners from across the textile value chain. He emphasised a strong belief in the value of textiles and highlighted the company’s readiness to invest in the future of both its partners and the wider sector. Chief executive officer Lutz Wolf described the new centre as a milestone for the company’s strategic development. With its new Textile Innovation Center, Karl Mayer aims to reinforce its role as a key innovation partner for the global textile industry, providing a platform where ideas are not only generated but brought into production-ready reality.

title: KARL MAYER - LinkedIn

Overview:
KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers a wide range of products and services of its sector with the focus on textile machinery building. The business activities are concentrated on the fields of warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation for weaving. KARL MAYER supports the success of its international customers with products and services that are outstanding in both economic and technical terms, as well as with innovations that move the textile world forward. KARL MAYER has employees all over the world. Thanks to its global organization and its claim to produce in its main markets, the company is always close to its customers and their needs. Today, it has subsidiaries in the USA, India, Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, China, Turkey, India and Switzerland, as well as agencies in all parts of the world. KARL MAYER is a German family-owned company, which has focused on financial independence and economic sustainability since its foundation in 1937. As a permanent, reliable partner with decades of experience and a high level of quality in all areas, it supports the competitiveness of its customers and business partners. title: KARL MAYER’s new manufacturing facility at Obertshausen - The Textile Magazine
content: * KARL MAYER’s new manufacturing facility at Obertshausen. The new assembly hall at KARL MAYER’s site in Obertshausen becomes operational. The hall was set up on the basis of state-of-the-art assembly logistics at KARL MAYER’s headquarters in Obertshausen. Mr. Herbert Lohr, Head of the Business Unit, (right), Mr. Burkhard Reith, Head of Machine Dispatch, (left) and Mr. Dominik Marton, an assistant in assembly and logistics, Karl Mayer. On November 1 last the first machine bed arrived at the new assembly hall. “We have installed a state-of-the-art assembly line here with optimum cycle times, from delivery of the parts and modules to dispatch,” explained Herbert Lohr, who was pleased that the assembly operations could now begin. According to the Head of KARL MAYER’s Warp Knitting Business Unit, “optimum” means maximum efficiency for the best quality, and is a guarantee of future success. “With the next generation of assembly operations, we are strengthening the competitiveness of the entire KARL MAYER Group,” adds Herbert Lohr.
